Reading Comprehension
Read the dialog and answer · Leia o diálogo e responda
Dialog — A Busy Week

Carlos: Hey Ana! How are you? Did you enjoy your weekend?

Ana: Yes I did! I met my colleague at the coffee shop on Saturday. She brought her friend too. We enjoyed talking all morning long.

Carlos: Could you go to the theater? I heard there is a new show there.

Ana: No, we couldn't. My colleague got tired and didn't feel well. So I took her home by car.

Carlos: That's too bad. What did you do after?

Ana: I went to the mall. I bought an expensive brand of clothes. I'll receive another package next week — I'm going to give it to my mother as a gift.

Carlos: Will she like it?

Ana: I think so! She always enjoyed receiving gifts. I called her yesterday and she said she will be happy.
